title: Honor Just Made a 5,500-Nit Watch… With NO ECG 😳
description:
Honor's new Watch 6 Pro hits up to 5,500 nits — but in Europe it ships without ECG.

Honor opened UK and EU pre-orders on 19 Nov 2026. It's a 1.5-inch tandem (two-layer) OLED with a 5,500-nit peak (4,500 across the whole screen, Honor says), up to 18 days of battery, a ceramic bezel, dual-band GPS, and it works with iPhone. Price: £329 / €379 (silver steel version £379 / €429), with early-bird offers through December. The catch: ECG, blood pressure trends and the cardiac warning haven't been announced for the UK and EU.

By our Spec or Wreck score: 60/100 → SPEC, if you want a bright watch that lasts. Not if you need heart checks.
